curated.notes: Go-wide tokens with anthems and Overrun. Forge's GO_WIDE plan wants two finishers it can hold until lethal (OVERRUN role) and 16 cheap bodies or token makers, which the deck has. PLAY_AGGRO lets the wide board attack instead of keeping every token home as a blocker (§17: notNeededAsBlockers is relaxed only by PLAY_AGGRO); token abilities are used every time. Key cards order the tutors (Harvest Season and Farhaven fetch lands, so mostly discard protection here) and the Monte Carlo plan.
curated.by: hand, from the decklist and Forge's plan detectors (DESIGN.md §19)

playbook.notes: Emmara makes a lifelink Soldier whenever she becomes tapped, so the deck is a token engine with anthems on top. The rules put the mana creatures and rocks down first, then Emmara, then Karametra's Favor and Presence of Gond on her and nowhere else; with Presence of Gond she taps for an Elf and a Soldier every turn before combat. Collective Unconscious and Camaraderie wait for five creatures and are not cast into a board of more than twelve or a library under forty (a draft decked itself that way). Overrun waits for five attackers. The permanents go down in the listed order, anthems first, including the three cards flagged AI:RemoveDeck:All that stock never casts (Dauntless Escort, Nullmage Shepherd, Slate of Ancestry). Permanents are cast in either main phase. Attack: go-wide at the highest life with the split, as version 2. Shipped 2026-11-11 as version 3 after ab-run #8: on the 200 tables of run #6 (seed 20261141) it wins 67 where stock wins 43 and the attack-only version 2 wins 39 (+12.0 points against stock, 47 tables won only by it against 23 only by stock, exact test 0.006); the same rules under the pressure attack win 60, and with everything but the anthems cast after combat 58 (demo-data/ab/2026-11-11-ab-v6/token-triumph.json, DESIGN.md §22). Confirmed on tables of its own (ab-run #17, seed 20261160, 200 tables whose opponents the deck had not met): 56 wins against stock's 35, 28.0% against 17.5%, +10.5 points (95% +3 to +18, 38 tables won only by it against 17 only by stock, exact test 0.0065; demo-data/ab/2026-11-11-ab-v10/token-triumph.json, DESIGN.md §23). Version 4 (2026-11-12): the attack is left to Forge. At 200 tables of bots (ab-run #23 joined with #20, seed 20261200) these rules won 93 tables with Forge's own attack against 83 with the go-wide attack (+5.0 points, 95% -1 to +11, exact test 0.17) and the stock pilot's 75 (+9.0, +1 to +17, 0.05).
